retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sepia-toned landscape featuring silhouetted palm trees against a hazy sunset with vintage Art Deco-inspired inline typography.
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast digital photography is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A nostalgic, warm-toned composition depicting two silhouetted palm trees on a thin horizon line, separating a hazy sky from shimmering water, framed by a thin cream border and featuring stylized inline lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical palm trees contrasting against horizontal water ripples
Warm golden light source on the left transitioning to deep amber on the right
Centered typography balancing the asymmetrical tree placement
Heavy film grain unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Monochromatic warm color palette (yellow to deep reddish-brown)
Thin solid-color border framing the entire image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two palm trees positioned slightly left of center, occupying the middle vertical third.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright golden light flare on the left horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright flare, up the palm trees, across the top text, and down to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive hazy sky and textured water surface create a sense of vastness.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high tonal warmth; values range from bright highlights to deep shadow without pure blacks.

letterConstructionRules: Internal inline or 'engraved' white line following the stroke
characterSpecificRedesigns: S has a distinctive vintage curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used in two different sizes for hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-waisted Art Deco feel
Similar flared terminals and classic structure

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, sepia-toned photograph of two palm trees silhouetted against a hazy sunset over the ocean. The light should flare from the left. Add a thin cream border around the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Overlay centered all-caps text at the top and bottom using an Art Deco serif font with an inline stroke effect in cream color.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm/sepia?
Is there a heavy film grain texture?
Does the text have a visible inline detail?

mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent sepia toning across sky and water
Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally
Verify the presence of the thin cream border
Confirm the inline detail is visible in the typography
recipe.reuseFormula: Vintage Sepia Landscape + Art Deco Inline Typography + Film Grain Texture
